enrichment.label: Automatic run names and summaries
enrichment.description: Stella reads captured turns and uses organization credits. Applies to this workspace. Turning this off shows run IDs; recorded repositories, files, outputs, and harness facts remain available.

run.noSummary: No summary yet. Open the transcript to review recorded prompts, model calls, and tools.

resolvedApprovals.title: Resolved
resolvedApprovals.empty: Nothing resolved for this run yet.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.digestOnly: The recorder kept a digest and no body, so there is nothing to read here.
transcript.noBody: No body was retained for this entry, or the bytes are not text.
transcript.truncated: Cut at the length one entry carries.
transcript.openFrame: Read the whole body of frame {seq}
transcript.empty: This run has no recorded frames yet.
transcript.complete: {count} entries. This is the whole run.
transcript.cut: {count} entries. The run has more frames than one read carries and the read offered no resume point, so this stops short of the end.
transcript.transportNote: The transport moves the viewer, never the run. Idle longer than 2 seconds is compressed, and the true elapsed time is shown beside the position.
transcript.recording: Recording. Every frame is hash-chained to its predecessor as it arrives, and this view follows the run's head and reads what it records.
transcript.emptyFiltered: No entry in this run answers to the {count} chips you pressed. Clear the filter to read the whole run.
transcript.loadedMore: {count} entries read so far. More lie past this page.
transcript.badCursor: That resume point is not one this read wrote, so the next page was refused. Everything above is still the record.
transcript.pageFailed: The next page could not be read. Everything above is still the record.
transcript.followDenied: Access to this run was refused. Ask a workspace Owner or organization Admin to restore access.
transcript.followLost: The connection to the live head dropped. The run kept recording; read more to catch up.
transcript.followSealed: The run sealed while you were following it. This is the whole recording.
transcript.noHalves: Neither half of this exchange was recorded. Its envelope is on the Frames tab.

frames.title: Frames
frames.empty: This run has no frames yet. A run with no frames has cost nothing.
frames.emptyPage: Nothing lies past the frame this page starts from.

body.title: Frame {seq} body
body.digestOnly: The recorder kept this frame's digest and no bytes, so there is no body to read. The digest still proves what was recorded.
body.notText: The retained bytes are not UTF-8 text, so they are not shown here. Read them through the API with get_run_frame_body and check them against the digest.

cost.title: Cost
cost.notRolledUp: The rollup has not rebuilt this run yet. It runs after a run seals, and until it has there is no figure to show. A zero here would be a measurement, and nothing has measured one.
cost.noModelCalls: No model call in this run was priced.

commands.reasonHelp: The model reads this on resume, and it is recorded with the command.
commands.steerHelp: Oxagen records this, quotes it, and hands it to the model as content. It is never executed.
commands.noRecipient: No live run took this command.
commands.ledgerReason: Pause refuses the next evidence batch. Resume reopens evidence ingress. Cancel revokes the run credentials. These controls do not stop the external process; steering needs a producer connection.
commands.roleReason: Sending a command needs an organization Owner or Admin role, or a workspace Owner or Member role.

pause.title: Pause {run}
pause.body: The agent stops at the next boundary it reaches. Work already in flight finishes first.
pause.queued: The pause is queued. It takes effect at the next boundary; the run's status says when it has.

resume.title: Resume {run}
resume.body: The agent carries on from where it paused. Your reason reaches the model as a control frame.
resume.queued: The resume is queued. The run's status says when the agent has picked it up.

steer.title: Steer {run}
steer.body: Your text reaches the model as a control frame. Pick when the agent sees it.
steer.queued: The steer is queued. It reaches the model at the next delivery point.

cancel.title: Cancel {run}
cancel.body: When the command is applied, Oxagen revokes the run token so no further governed call succeeds. Killing the process itself is best effort, and either way it is recorded.
cancel.queued: The cancel is queued. Nothing has changed yet: the token is revoked and the process kill attempted when the command is applied, so until then the run can still make governed calls.

failure.orgRoleRequired: This needs an organization Owner or Admin role.
failure.noPrincipal: This call carries no principal Oxagen can act as.
failure.runNotFound: This run is not in this workspace.
failure.noConnectionPoint: A ledger run has no connection point to carry a command.
failure.runSealed: This run has ended, so nothing can receive the command.
failure.noHost: This run names no enrolled host, so nothing can receive the command. Nothing was queued.
failure.hostRevoked: This run's host was revoked and no longer collects commands. Nothing was queued.
failure.hostOffline: This run's host has not checked for commands in the last five minutes, so nothing would read this one. Nothing was queued.
failure.noPromptCarrier: This agent reads steering text only when a session starts, so this run would never see it. Pause, resume and cancel still reach it. Nothing was queued.
failure.runNotSealed: This run is still live. Both of these need a complete record, so they run after the seal.
failure.digestOnly: This recording kept digests and no bodies, so there is nothing for a model to read.
failure.steerText: Steering text is required, and it has a length limit.
failure.refused: The control plane refused this: {code}. Nothing was queued.
failure.invalid: The control plane refused these values. Nothing was queued.
failure.pendingApproval: This is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The control plane answered {code}. Nothing was queued, and the run kept recording.
failure.forkRequiresLedger: Forking needs an evidence-ledger run. A wrapped session has no attempt to branch from.
failure.gradeBelowFork: This recording is graded below fork, so the cassette would have a hole in it. Nothing was minted.
failure.seqPastSeal: That frame is past the last one this run recorded.
failure.gapBeforeSeq: A frame before that point kept no body, so the replay would have a hole before the branch. Nothing was minted.
failure.fromSeq: The branch point is a frame sequence number of at least 1.
failure.runB: Name a second run to compare against, and not this one.
failure.deliveryMode: Pick one of the three delivery modes. Nothing was queued.
failure.commandReason: Keep the reason to {max} characters or fewer. Nothing was queued.
failure.rowCommand: A run's row sends a pause, a resume or a cancel. Nothing was queued.

blocked.runSealed: This run has ended, so there is nothing to pause, steer or cancel.
blocked.noHost: This run names no enrolled host. Commands reach a run through its host, so there is nothing to pause, steer or cancel.
blocked.hostRevoked: This run's host was revoked. A revoked host no longer collects commands, so there is nothing to pause, steer or cancel.
blocked.hostOffline: This run's host has not checked for commands in the last five minutes. It may have stopped or lost its connection, so a command would go unread. The controls come back when the host checks in.

nextStep.label: Before the next model call
nextStep.help: The agent finishes the step it is on, then reads your text on its next model request.

interrupt.label: Interrupt the step in flight
interrupt.help: The step running now is cut short so your text lands sooner. A connection point that cannot interrupt carries it at the next model call, or at the end of the turn when it cannot reach a model call, and records which.

turnBoundary.label: At the end of the turn
turnBoundary.help: The agent finishes the whole turn, then reads your text before it starts the next one.

delivery.ceiling: This is a ceiling. The run's connection point carries the strongest mode it can at or below it, and the command records both what you asked for and what it carried.

ledgerCancel.body: Cancel revokes this run’s evidence credentials and refuses further appends. It does not stop the external process or prove that its work has stopped.
ledgerCancel.applied: Further appends are refused and the run’s evidence credentials are revoked. The external process may still be running.

commands.ledgerRevoked: Evidence ingress is revoked. This run cannot append more frames or receive a fresh run credential. Its external process may still be running.
commands.ledgerPaused: Evidence ingress is paused. New batches are refused until you resume. The external process may still be running.

ledgerPause.body: Pause refuses new evidence batches at the next ingest boundary. It does not stop the external process.
ledgerPause.applied: Evidence ingress is paused. The external process may still be running.

ledgerResume.body: Resume accepts new evidence batches again. A producer whose credential expired while paused needs a fresh run credential.
ledgerResume.applied: Evidence ingress is open. This does not claim that the external process has resumed.

commands.ledgerReasonHelp: The reason is recorded with the command. Oxagen does not send it to the external process.

summarize.title: Summarize {run}
summarize.body: A fast model reads this run's transcript and writes its name and what changed. The result is labelled generated wherever it shows, and the frames stay the record. The call is metered like any other.
summarize.queued: The summary is queued. It appears on this run once the model has written it.
summarize.needsRole: Summarizing needs an organization Owner, Admin or Member role.
summarize.needsBodies: This recording kept digests and no bodies, so there is nothing for a model to read. Summarizing is refused.

export.title: Export {run}
export.body: Oxagen queues a signed bundle: the frame envelopes as NDJSON, the Merkle root, an attestation, the verifying key id, and a script that verifies all of it offline.
export.needsRole: Exporting a signed bundle needs an organization Owner or Admin role.

status.queued: Waiting for the job to start.

export.stalled: The bundle is not ready yet. Check again in a minute.
export.expiresHint: Check again for a new link after it expires.
export.copyFailed: This browser refused the clipboard. Select the digest and copy it.
export.failedUnrecorded: The export failed, and the job recorded no error.

readFailure.notFound: This export is not in this workspace.
readFailure.denied: Reading an export needs an organization Owner or Admin role.
readFailure.other: Oxagen answered {code} when asked for this export.

run.gaps: The seal recorded these gaps in the record:

gap.body_missing: a frame carried content whose body was not retained
gap.tool_bodies: no tool result body was retained
gap.hooks_partial: a hook entry is missing for part of the session
gap.unobserved_tail: the process ended without a terminal event
gap.chain_break: the hash chain does not hold end to end
gap.telemetry_gap: telemetry stopped for part of the run

chain.title: Chain and seal
chain.prefix: This walk stopped before the end of the recording, so these are the gaps of the part it read, not of the whole run.
chain.noGaps: The walk found no missing sequence and no missing body, and the seal recorded no gap.
chain.unsealed: This run has no seal yet. A seal is written when the run ends, and it is what an attestation signs.
chain.noCheckpoints: This recording carries no checkpoint. A ledger run commits at its seal rather than along the way, so there is nothing missing here.
chain.ladderWhy: The grade above is the one the seal recorded, and it is what this run allows. The ladder is why: each rung names what carries it or the single thing missing. A rung may read stronger than the recorded grade, and nothing here raises it.
chain.ladderNoGrade: This run's seal recorded no grade, so nothing here states one. The ladder says what the recording holds.

gap.body_missing: a frame carried content whose body was not retained
gap.tool_bodies: no tool result body was retained
gap.hooks_partial: a hook entry is missing for part of the session
gap.unobserved_tail: the process ended without a terminal event
gap.chain_break: the hash chain does not hold end to end
gap.telemetry_gap: telemetry stopped for part of the run

waterfall.title: Run waterfall
waterfall.noCost: this turn's cost was not recorded
waterfall.empty: This run has no turn the recording could fold, so there is nothing to lay out.
waterfall.unpriced: No turn in this run carries a cost, so the bars have no scale to sit against. The turns and their steps are listed as recorded.
waterfall.cut: This stops short of the end of the run: the run is still recording, or it has more turns and steps than these reads carry.

replay.forkNeedsLedger: Forking replays an attempt from the evidence ledger. This run was recorded by a wrapped agent, which has no attempt to branch from.
replay.forkNoGrade: This run's seal recorded no replay grade, so Oxagen cannot say the recording is complete enough to fork.
replay.forkNeedsGrade: This recording is graded {grade}. Forking needs a recording graded fork, because every body before the branch point has to be there.

fork.title: Fork {run}
fork.body: Frames up to the one you name replay from this recording. The next model call runs live, and a tool result after it is served from the recorded cassette when its input digest matches and refused when it does not. Oxagen mints the attempt and records where it branched; the engine that admitted the run is what resumes it.
fork.seqHelp: The last recorded frame the fork replays, as a sequence number of at least 1.
fork.minted: The attempt is minted. It resumes when the engine that admitted the run picks it up.

bisect.title: Bisect {run} against another run
bisect.body: Both recordings are read frame by frame, and each frame is reduced to its kind and the identity of what it did. The first position whose keys differ is the divergence. Bodies are not read, so this works on any recording.
bisect.otherHelp: A run id from this workspace, such as arun_01k4qj9e or tse_7k2m9q.
bisect.same: The two runs agree at every frame. {aligned} frames were compared.
bisect.diverged: The runs diverge at frame {seq}, after {aligned} frames that agreed.

outputs.label: What this run produced
outputs.title: What this run produced, in the order it happened
outputs.frameTitle: Open the frame that recorded this
outputs.locator: The ledger recorded this change without its path.
outputs.gateHint: The run is stopped here until someone answers.
outputs.empty: No file or output evidence was captured for this run. Recorded frames may still contain activity.
outputs.footer: Ordered by the frames, not by kind. A read is a mark, never a change. A gate sits where it stopped the run.
outputs.cut: This run produced more than one read carries, so the spine ends early.

tokenUsage.title: Reported tokens
tokenUsage.missing: Token usage was not recorded for these frames.
tokenUsage.coverage: Counts cover loaded frames. Missing counts remain unknown. Cache reads are input too. These counts do not identify which input content was useful.

header.paused: Ingress is paused. The agent takes no new step until you resume it.
header.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it.
header.noMachineOnLedger: The evidence ledger records no host for a run.

issues.title: Issues
issues.task: Task the run was started on
issues.note: The record keeps one task reference per run. Links to other issues are not captured.

policy.title: Policy decisions
policy.empty: No policy decision was recorded on this run.
policy.onlyChecks: Neither Oxagen policy nor an operator made a decision on this run. The agent harness's own checks are listed below.
policy.checks: {count, plural, one {# harness check} other {# harness checks}}
policy.cut: The transcript read stopped short, so later decisions are missing here.

context.title: Recalled context
context.cut: The transcript read stopped short, so later recalls are missing here.

work.label: The work
work.diffStat: {added} added, {removed} removed in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
work.openDiff: Open the diff in the transcript
work.noSpend: No cost rollup yet. It is built after the run seals.

workCi.title: Work and CI
workCi.basis: Recorded checkouts and connected pull requests. Branch matches show related work, not authorship.
workCi.failedChecks: {count, plural, one {# failing check} other {# failing checks}}
workCi.stale: Head moved or could not be verified
workCi.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the path to copy it.
workCi.prMissing: No connected pull request was found in the available evidence.

ci.neutral: No failing checks in the returned results

workCi.diffFiles: {count, plural, one {# diff file} other {# diff files}}
workCi.diffBasis: A snapshot compares the observed working tree with its recorded baseline. It can include changes made before the run.
workCi.diffMissing: No patch bytes were captured in the available frames. File observations may still appear in Outputs.
workCi.incomplete: Some work or provider evidence is unavailable or outside this read’s limits.
